answers.question: Are my conversations used for model training by default?
answers.answer: Yes, your conversations are used for model training by default. You can opt out by turning off 'Improve the model for everyone' in Settings > Data controls, which will exclude new conversations from training. Managed business and education workspaces and temporary chats are not used for training by default.

answers.question: How long are my conversations kept?
answers.answer: Your conversations remain in your account until you delete them. Once deleted, they are scheduled for permanent deletion within 30 days, with exceptions for de-identified data and legal or security requirements.

citations.title: Deleting and archiving chats in ChatGPT

answers.question: How can I stop my conversations being used for training?
answers.answer: You can stop your conversations from being used for training by turning off 'Improve the model for everyone' in Settings > Data controls. Note that if you provide feedback on a conversation, it may still be used for training even with this setting off.

answers.question: How can I delete my conversations?
answers.answer: Use the conversation menu, select Delete, and confirm. Deleted chats disappear from your account view immediately and are scheduled for deletion within 30 days, with exceptions for de-identified data and legal or security requirements.

citations.title: Deleting and archiving chats in ChatGPT
